title: Tak Boleh Bungkus
subject: a coconut seller on the Teluk Cempedak beach road in Kuantan who refuses to let anyone take a coconut away, making a customer in a hurry sit on his plastic stool and drink it there
caption: Malay roots reggae with a Nusantara touch. A one-drop drum kit with a cross-stick snare landing on the third beat; a deep, round electric bass playing slow melodic lines; a clean electric guitar chopping the off-beat skank; a melodica answering the vocal with short phrases; a rebana hand drum tapping light fills. Warm and roomy, bass heavy, spring reverb and tape-delay echoes on the melodica and the snare. Male voice, relaxed mid-baritone, conversational and slightly behind the beat, with soft harmony 'ooh's in the chorus. 74 BPM, G major. Unhurried, sunny and dryly funny. No ska horn section, no fast tempo, no autotune, no trap beat, no dancehall synth bass.
lyrics:
[Intro - melodica over the one-drop]

[Verse 1]
Jalan pantai Teluk Cempedak
Pak Lah duduk bawah payung koyak
Parang di tangan, kelapa bertimbun
Aku brek kereta, tergesa-gesa

[Pre-Chorus]
"Pak Lah, bungkus satu, saya dah lambat"
Dia senyum, tunjuk bangku plastik

[Chorus - lead with soft 'ooh' harmonies]
Tak boleh bungkus, tak boleh bungkus
Air kelapa minum kat sini
Duduk dulu, angin pun percuma
Tak boleh bungkus, undang-undang Pak Lah

[Verse 2]
Tiga kali tetak, kelapa terbuka
Hulur straw, sudu dari kulit kelapa
Cerita pasal ombak, pasal cucu main bola
Telefon aku bergetar, aku buat tak tahu

[Chorus - lead with soft 'ooh' harmonies]
Tak boleh bungkus, tak boleh bungkus
Air kelapa minum kat sini
Bos aku telefon, biar dia tunggu
Tak boleh bungkus, undang-undang Pak Lah

[Bridge - bass and melodica, drums drop out]
Setengah jam untuk sebiji kelapa
Mesyuarat pun tak lari ke mana

[Chorus - lead with soft 'ooh' harmonies]
Tak boleh bungkus, tak boleh bungkus
Esok aku datang awal sikit
Bawa kawan, bawa bangku sendiri
Tak boleh bungkus, undang-undang Pak Lah

[Outro - melodica and dub echoes]
